AhR expressed on mesenchymal stromal cells is involved in the modulation of macrophage polarization and asthma pathogenesis.

the role of AhRs in the modulation of macrophage polarization and asthma pathogenesis, which may have implications for the treatment of asthma.

MSC can attenuate CRE-induced asthma by modulating macrophage polarization via activation of AhRs.
